, despite some difficulties in grafting, the phosphonated ionic liquids can be successfully anchored onto the γ-Al2O3 powders and that this grafting is stable under various conditions.
the phosphonyl groups are grafted on the alumina surface, but the ionic liquids do not form a continuous film on the surface, and the phosphonyl group is the main part of the grafting process.

the ionic liquid grafted on γ-Al2O3 is an effective model for a possible future use of ionic liquids as hybrid membranes.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the grafting of ionic liquid molecules on γ-alumine powders can be achieved without the need for a pre-activation of the surface.
grafting of phosphonyl groups onto γ-alumina powders was possible and the phosphonated ionic liquid (Phos-IL) grafted powders showed a high affinity for CO2, with a selectivity of up to 20.
